task: ae.minisql: SQL subset engine with NAIVE and OPTIMIZED planners verified by randomized differential and collection-oracle tests
reasoning_summary: Designed a lexer, recursive-descent parser, binder with static checks and a three-valued-logic evaluator, then two executors: nested-loop and hash-join with safe predicate pushdown (never into the right side of a LEFT JOIN). 55 tests: hand-computed cases, error messages with positions, atomicity and rollback, plan assertions, LIKE vs regex oracle, and 1800 random queries compared across planners plus independent collection oracles. Mutation kill-checks killed all non-equivalent mutants.
